after.zh: 步幅为 2，输出就隔一个取一个。一般地，输出边长 = ⌊(N + 2p − k) / s⌋ + 1：N 是输入边长，k 是窗口大小，p 是补边宽度，s 是步幅。这一层只有 9 个要学的数，图变大变小都一样，因为同一组权重在每个位置都用：这叫权重共享。看评分里的「参数」。
after.en: With a stride of 2, the output keeps every other position. In general, output width = ⌊(N + 2p − k) / s⌋ + 1, with N the input width, k the window size, p the padding and s the stride. This layer has only 9 numbers to learn, however big or small the picture, because the same weights are used at every position: this is called weight sharing. See "Parameters" in the score.

t.zh: 到现在为止，元件的输出都和输入一样大。真正的卷积网络里，图往往一层层变小：一张照片几百万个像素，缩小之后，后面的层才算得动。
t.en: So far every part's output has been as big as its input. In a real convolutional network the picture usually shrinks layer by layer: a photo has millions of pixels, and only after shrinking can the later layers keep up.

t.zh: 卷积层的窗口就是你熟悉的 3×3 核：停在图上一处，算出一个数，再挪到下一处。每次挪几格，叫步幅。
t.en: A convolution layer's window is the familiar 3×3 kernel: it stops at one place, works out a number, then moves on. How far it moves each time is the stride.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：做出一层步幅为 2 的卷积，权重由训练找出来。测试图有两种大小。要想的问题：图变大时，这一层要学的数会不会跟着变多？
t.en: Your task in this level: make a convolution layer with stride 2, with its weights found by training. The test pictures come in two sizes. Something to think about: when the picture gets bigger, does this layer have more numbers to learn?

caption.zh: 第一组：字母 F，输出只有一半大
caption.en: Set 1: the letter F, with an output half the size

brief.zh: 一层卷积的窗口每次挪两格，输出边长只有输入的一半。窗口里的 3×3 权重不知道，要训练出来。测试图有 16×16 的，也有 12×12 的：同一个电路都要对。
brief.en: A convolution layer whose window moves two pixels at a time, so the output is half the input's width. The 3×3 weights in the window are unknown and have to be trained. Some test pictures are 16×16 and some 12×12: the same circuit must be right for both.

hint.zh: 窗口每次挪两格，等于先在每个位置都算一遍，再隔一个留一个。
hint.en: Moving the window two pixels at a time is the same as computing at every position and then keeping every other one.
